updates: macOS builds are paused for now. This build ships for Windows and Linux only, and macOS will come back in a later build.
Download errors now tell you what to do about a full disk, a folder you can't write to, a bad checksum or a blocked address.
Skills switched on past the 40th can still be used.
fixes: Model downloads on Windows no longer fail with "URL refused by outbound security policy".
Closing or crashing Draggy no longer leaves llama-server or shell processes running.
MCP tools that only claim to be read-only now ask before they run, and web fetches stop at 16 MiB.
When several files change at once, every one of them is picked up, so open canvases no longer go stale.
Enter with an input method editor, Escape in menus and rename, and retry on the crash screen work again.
AI could not read videos because of "Disabled tools" but now can.

updates: You can now attach videos to a chat
The local API now supports all major ai coding harnesses such as codex, claude code and cline as well as openwebui and uses their format of tools & messages.
fixes: Replies in chats signed in with an account are no longer empty
Tool calls and follow-up messages in ChatGPT chats now work
Browser tool calls are now shown as completed instead of failed all the time
